name: Kurikoma Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of the Kurikoma volcano straddling Iwate, Miyagi, Akita and Yamagata, with crater lakes, alpine meadows and autumn colors.
notes: Managed by Miyagi. The summit and the Iwakagami pond are the classic routes.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)

ja.name: 栗駒国定公園
ja.description: 岩手・宮城・秋田・山形にまたがる栗駒山の国定公園。火口湖や高山のお花畑、紅葉が見どころ。
